review.note: 2026-10-31 direct-dependency review for hbrowser 0.46.0 and the approved mutually authenticated forwarding protocol. Raised websockets minimum to 17.4: the official stable changelog identifies the newly enforced 4096-fragment recv limit as a memory-exhaustion security fix across implementations; 17.4 also makes ConnectionClosed exception chaining consistent. No insecure old forwarding protocol fallback is retained. Fresh single-checkout scripts/rebuild-env.sh resolution installed websockets 17.4 and Python 3.14.8. Official new-release notes reviewed: hatchling 1.33.0 adds Python 3.15 support; pytest 9.2.0 adjusts config validation, plugin import error classification and keyword-only parametrize options; mypy 2.4.1 fixes two-phase overload handling and nested-function mypyc frame setup; Ruff 0.17.2/0.17.3 fix starred type variables, comment-preserving fixes, f-string rewriting and formatting/performance; markdownlint-cli2 0.24.0 updates dependencies, including markdownlint 0.42.0, and requires Node >=22 (local Node 24.22.1). URLs: https://websockets.readthedocs.io/en/stable/project/changelog.html ; https://hatch.pypa.io/latest/history/hatchling/ ; https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/changelog.html ; https://mypy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/changelog.html ; https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/releases/tag/0.17.2 ; https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/releases/tag/0.17.3 ; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DavidAnson/markdownlint-cli2/v0.24.0/CHANGELOG.md . Unchanged direct versions and their compatibility bounds reuse the explicit 2026-10-24 audit's attributed official release-note/README/sdist research: asyncio-atexit 1.0.1, beautifulsoup4 4.15.0, h2h-galleryinfo-parser 0.5.3, httpx 0.28.1, zendriver 0.17.1, build 1.6.1, distlib 0.4.4 and packaging 26.3. Retain exact zendriver==0.17.1 as the documented lifecycle cohort; existing asyncio-atexit <2 and parser <0.6 compatibility bounds remain. Parser public release notes remain unavailable; asyncio-atexit's previously inspected official sdist has README but no changelog. Current-environment normal fast hook passed (144 formatted files, strict mypy 131 files, 3 Markdown files); prior source-equivalent author tests passed 1056 tests/458 subtests with 2 platform skips using the older dependency cohort. Current-dependency full lifecycle/navigation/challenge/timeout/process-tree validation and installed-wheel smoke are required separately before merge; metadata compatibility is not behavioral or Windows-platform proof.
